aiMetadata.description: Creates a personal-video Greet task in Bonjoro for a recipient identified by email (upserting their profile first), with a note and optional assignee, campaign, and message template. Use to queue a new outreach video for a customer. Not idempotent: each call creates a new Greet, so repeating it produces duplicates.
